subject: Oxysystems payment timeline and VAT coordination
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@oxysystems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Muir <sophie.muir@oxysystems.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Payment timing and VAT treatment for Q4 run rate

Hi Evelyn,

Hope youre well. Quick one from our side as we plan the FY27 cash flow: would Redwood be open to moving the pilot billing to Net60 for the next two invoice cycles? Were ramping consumption faster than expected and Net60 would give our finance team the runway to smooth payments.

We're happy to provide VAT registration and any additional evidence you need; Oxysystems is VAT-registered in Ireland (ROI). If we can agree Net60 for Sep/Oct invoices with a temporary credit increase to EUR 75,000 for the pilot period, we can commit to the usage ramp targets in the appendix of the SOW.

What we need from you:
- Confirmation of temporary credit ceiling and who at Redwood owns the decision
- Any required VAT evidence list so we can attach the cert right away
- Expected invoice date for the initial 30% prepay (if required)

Thanks for considering — can we get a response by Thursday so our AP team can plan?

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations, Oxysystems
finance@oxysystems.com

Attachments: none in this message
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@oxysystems.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment timing and VAT treatment for Q4 run rate

Hi Liam,

Thanks for the clear ask and the heads-up on the ramp. Were supportive of being flexible for pilots, but we have to balance credit risk and VAT compliance. Proposed path that should keep both sides comfortable:

1) Terms: Net45 for the next two billing cycles (instead of Net60), with review after the second invoice.
2) Credit: temporary increase to EUR 50,000 to cover the pilot period; additional capacity can be reviewed on receipt of usage metrics and pending payment performance.
3) Upfront: a one-time 30% initial invoice on contract amendment signature to reduce our exposure — that invoice can be issued the business day after we receive the signed amendment.
4) VAT evidence: please provide a copy of your ROI VAT registration (VAT cert), and confirmation of billing entity (legal name and VAT ID). For EU cross-border flows we also need the AP contact and a remit address.

Ive attached a proforma invoice showing the 30% prepay and a draft amendment to the Master SAAS Agreement that implements Net45 and the temporary credit cap. If you can return the VAT cert and a signed amendment link by end of next week, we can move forward on the schedule.

Im ccing Kimberly (Finance) and Rishi (Account Exec) to handle the credit approval and to align on invoicing cadence.

Proposed invoice cadence if we proceed:
- Day 0: Amendment signed -> issue 30% proforma (payment due Net45)
- Day 30: First consumption invoice for prior month (Net45)
- Review: after two invoices well reassess terms and credit ceiling

Let me know if the above hits the right balance and well trigger legal/docuSign.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- 2026-09-09-Proforma-invoice-OX-0421.pdf (PDF, 22KB)
- Amendment_to_SAAS_Agreement_OX-0421.docx (DOCX, 38KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 15:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment timing and VAT treatment for Q4 run rate

Eve / Rishi,

Quick internal note after reviewing the ask:
- Finance is comfortable with a temporary credit cap of EUR 50,000 for Oxysystems (pilot only) with the Net45 terms Evelyn proposed.
- Well require the 30% prepay invoice to be cleared (or at least a confirmed payment date) before we enable any additional usage beyond the initial commit.
- If AP provides VAT cert and the legal billing entity matches the SOW, we can waive the need for additional POs for this pilot.

Operational items:
- Rishi: please confirm the customer will sign the amendment via DocuSign. Once signed, Finance will queue the proforma for issuance (expected next business day).
- Evelyn: please include AP remit details in the DocuSign envelope so we get a clear invoice-to address for EU VAT purposes.

From a risk perspective we should run a soft credit check (low friction) if their outstanding balance exceeds the cap during the pilot — flag me if usage suggests we should pause.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
